add.k: Sam Guthrie's father, a coal miner in Kentucky
st: In season 5, Ed Guthrie is pulled from a mine cave-in by his son Sam, then stands by him when the town drives the family out.

files.notes: Hidden Agendas (Wikipedia #74, S5). Named on screen: Kirkland says 'That's what I keep telling the boy, Ed' and 'Ed, Ellen, good seeing you'; a neighbor says 'I'm sorry, Ed' to the mob. Surname said throughout ('Sam Guthrie', 'them Guthries'). He works in the mines, but no mining company is named on screen, so Independent.

add.k: Sam Guthrie's mother in Cumberland, Kentucky
st: In season 5, Ellen Guthrie urges her son Sam to look beyond the mines, then packs up to leave town when the neighbors turn on him.

files.notes: Hidden Agendas (Wikipedia #74). Named when Kirkland says 'Ed, Ellen, good seeing you' and a neighbor says 'It ain't you or Ellen'. Her lines: 'I just can't take the both of you working in those mines. You got to start thinking about the future, Sam.' No group named on screen: Independent.

add.k: A Shi'ar scout mapping dead star systems
st: In season 3, aboard a Shi'ar scout ship in the D'Bari system, Eluke tracks a fiery creature that dives into a star and feeds on it.

files.notes: The Dark Phoenix, Part III (Wikipedia #42, S3; Marvel Database lists it as Season 3 13). Named by his captain: 'Life readings, Eluke?', 'Eluke! What was that?'. His lines include 'According to my readings, Captain, the creature is still alive.' Subtitles carry no speaker names, so the split of lines between Eluke and the captain is inferred from the dialogue.

add.k: A short, tough acrobat of Alpha Flight
st: In season 2, Puck helps Alpha Flight capture Wolverine for Department H, then joins the team's break in to free him.

files.notes: Repo Man (Wikipedia #18, S2). Named in dialogue ('Losing your touch, Puck'); speaks ('Funny you should ask', 'Better listen to the Frenchies, big fellow'). His real name Eugene Judd is never said. The Marvel Database image comes from X-Men '97 S1 E10, but no line or name there could be confirmed (no transcript mention), so no X-Men '97 step was written; add one if the build confirms a visible appearance.

add.k: An archaeologist chasing the legend of Cyttorak
st: In season 4, Eugene finds the ruby of Cyttorak and becomes a new Juggernaut, until Wolverine takes the gem and he turns back to normal.

files.notes: The Juggernaut Returns (Wikipedia #46, S4; Marvel Database Season 3 17). He says his own full name into his recorder ('Eugene Torbett Widerspahn' in the subtitles); the spelling follows the wiki page. He is a bystander who gains the power by accident and works for no one, so a Compound file. No group named: Independent.

add.k: A huge, near unbreakable mutant thug
st: In season 1, Blob is a collared slave on Genosha who joins Jubilee's revolt, then tries to kill Senator Kelly with Mystique's gang.
In season 2, Blob pulls a job with Avalanche and Pyro, then brawls with the X-Men outside Midtown Hospital while Mystique stalks Rogue.

files.notes: Slave Island (#7), Days of Future Past Part II (#12), A Rogue's Tale (#22), Wikipedia numbering. Blob is not named in Slave Island (only a 'BLOB ROARING' subtitle cue), so the S1 step uses the name from #12, where it is said ('Lovely sentiment, old Blob', 'Nothing hurts the Blob!'). In #12 Storm freezes him in ice; no arrest is shown, so At large. Group: the word 'Brotherhood' is not in the transcripts; 'The Brotherhood' is the app's existing name for Mystique's gang (fox-anim-mystique tm), used here; switch to Independent if the build requires a spoken name. Skipped: Sanctuary Part I (#48), where Marvel Database lists him only on a screen; One Man's Worth (#54), a different reality's Blob; X-Men '97, where he is only a silent cameo or a form Morph takes.

add.k: An ancient stone god of the Savage Land
st: In season 3, the stone god Garokk tricks Sauron into unleashing Storm's powers, but Sauron drains him and he is trapped in stone again.

files.notes: Savage Land, Strange Heart Parts 1 and 2 (Wikipedia #38 and #39, S3). Named and speaking throughout. His priestess Zaladane serves him, but no group is named: Independent. He ends locked back in stone ('I was so close'); Captive is the closest Raft status.

add.k: The general in charge of Canada's Department H
st: In season 2, General Chasen has Alpha Flight bring Wolverine back to Department H to dissect him, until the team rebels and frees him.

files.notes: Repo Man (Wikipedia #18). Named ('General Chasen can tell you more about it', 'Chasen!'). The group is named on screen: 'Department H and its enforcement arm, Alpha Flight'. Department H is not yet in groups_in_app; it is a new group name taken from the dialogue. 'team:Alpha Flight' in opp follows the 'team:The X-Men' pattern; drop it if the build only takes person ids. His fate after Alpha Flight frees Wolverine is not shown.

add.k: A stretchy, gooey Nasty Boy who serves Mister Sinister
st: In season 2, Gorgeous George and the Nasty Boys attack Scott and Jean for Mister Sinister, then deliver them to him in the Savage Land.
In season 4, he helps the Nasty Boys snatch Jean on her wedding day, then is called in to cover Sinister's grab for Xavier.

files.notes: Till Death Do Us Part Part Two (#15), Reunion Parts 1 and 2 (#25, #26), Beyond Good and Evil Part 1 (#63), Wikipedia numbering. Named in dialogue: 'Come to Gorgeous, pretty boy!', 'Hey, Gorgeous!' (#15), 'Very thoughtful, George' (#25), 'George, it is time' (#63). 'The Nasty Boys' is said on screen in #63. Skipped: Savage Land Part 2 recap, and cameos in Sanctuary Part I (#48) and Beyond Good and Evil Part 4 (#66).

add.k: A government recruiter with a hidden agenda
st: In season 5, Kirkland courts Sam Guthrie for a secret mutant weapons program, then orders the X-Men eliminated after they foil him.

files.notes: Hidden Agendas (Wikipedia #74). The wiki page calls him Girkland, but the dialogue says 'Mr. Kirkland' again and again, so n is Kirkland. He says he works for the government; Beast calls the program a renegade operation; no group or agency is named on screen, so Independent. The Marvel Database credits him with 'Hodge was right about the X-Men. Their elimination just became our top priority'; subtitles have no speaker names, so that attribution follows the wiki.

add.k: A hunter who does Mojo's dirty work
st: In season 3, Gog follows Mojo to Earth to hunt down Longshot, but the X-Men wreck the hunt and Mojo's broadcast falls apart.

files.notes: Longshot (Wikipedia #36, S3; Marvel Database Season 5 5). Named by Mojo again and again ('Gog, where's Gog?', 'Gog, cancel this little mophead!', 'Gog! Spiral! Get this freak off of me!'). Subtitles have no speaker names, so his own lines are inferred. Group: 'Mojo's network' is the app's existing name for Mojo's operation (used in the Longshot file); Mojo's crew is never given a group name on screen.

add.k: A governor who opposes Killgrave's power grab
st: In season 3, Governor Barkley fights Killgrave's bid for the Platte River Project until Killgrave takes over his mind and he resigns.

files.notes: No Mutant Is an Island (Wikipedia #34, S3). No wiki page under this title. Named by the newscaster ('Governor Barkley has announced he's resigning'); he speaks on the news ('Something he'll do over my dead body!'), and Killgrave visits him ('You know what I want, Governor'). No state or office is named as a group, so Independent. No ties: Killgrave is not in the app's network for this title.

add.k: The woman who once nursed Wolverine back to health
st: In season 2, Heather, who once nursed Wolverine back to health, runs his tests for Department H, then quits to stop his dissection.

files.notes: Repo Man (Wikipedia #18). Only 'Heather' is said on screen; she calls Vindicator (James) 'my husband', but 'Hudson' is never spoken, so n is Heather. She is in charge of Wolverine's testing for Department H ('I'm afraid I am') and says 'Effective immediately, I quit!', hence the two tm stages. Her photo in Weapon X, Lies, and Video Tape (#61) is not an appearance.

add.k: A catlike crew member of Corsair's Starjammers
st: In season 3, Hepzibah flies with Corsair's Starjammers against D'Ken, then comes to Earth with them and clashes with Storm over Jandra.

files.notes: The Phoenix Saga Parts IV and V (#32, #33) and Orphan's End (#44), Wikipedia numbering. Named by Corsair ('Come, Hepzibah'); speaks in #44 ('Surrender now, flying one!').

add.k: A geneticist who rules the hidden valley of Wundagore
st: In season 4, the High Evolutionary traps Magneto and his twins in Wundagore to breed a new race from their DNA, then flees the X-Men.

files.notes: Family Ties (Wikipedia #58, S4). Names himself ('I am the High Evolutionary'); the name Herbert Wyndham is never said. His creations are never called New Men on screen, so Independent. Skipped: a silent, unnamed figure in Garokk's tale in Savage Land Part 2 (#39), which the wiki says is him; the screen never says so.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ed and Ellen worry about their son Sam working the mines and urge him toward a better future. When the town turns on Sam, they pack up and leave Cumberland together.
stages.whoA: His wife, Sam's mother
stages.whoB: Her husband, Sam's father

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ed welcomes Kirkland into his home and backs his offer of a government scholarship for Sam. Kirkland is really after Sam for a living weapons program, and Ed learns of the trick when Sam runs home to warn them.
stages.whoA: A recruiter who pretends to help his son
stages.whoB: The miner whose son he wants

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ellen hosts Kirkland when he visits to press Sam about his offer, and he promises they will bring Sam around. Behind their backs he plans a less subtle approach to take her son.
stages.whoA: A recruiter who pretends to help her son
stages.whoB: The mother he charms to reach Sam

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Posing as Ms. LeBeau, Rogue hears from Sam about Kirkland's mutant Peace Corps and the X-Men trace it to a front. Kirkland's people try to drive her out, and she helps Sam slip their trap.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who exposes his program
stages.whoB: A recruiter running a secret mutant program

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gambit breaks into the empty Richmond office behind Kirkland's program and is caught and fitted with control implants. Xavier and Beast get him out.
stages.whoA: The thief caught snooping in his operation
stages.whoB: The man whose program captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Eluke's scout ship sees a fiery creature feed on a star, and his captain calls Empress Lilandra. She orders the ship home instead of pursuing it.
stages.whoA: His empress, who calls the ship home
stages.whoB: A scout whose ship reports the creature

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck fights his old teammate Wolverine with Alpha Flight and helps chain him for Department H. When the team learns Chasen means to dissect him, Puck joins the break in that frees him.
stages.whoA: His old Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: An Alpha Flight teammate from his past

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck serves in Alpha Flight, the enforcement arm of Chasen's Department H, and helps bring Wolverine in. When Chasen's real plan comes out, Puck and the team fight past his androids.
stages.whoA: A Department H agent who turns on him
stages.whoB: The general who misleads his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Heather runs Department H's tests on Wolverine for General Chasen. When Chasen orders the skeleton removed, she quits and stands against him.
stages.whoA: A scientist who quits on him
stages.whoB: The general she quits rather than obey

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chasen says Department H invested a lot in Wolverine and wants a return. He has him chained and probed, then orders his skeleton cut out, until Alpha Flight frees him.
stages.whoA: The deserter whose skeleton he wants
stages.whoB: The general who wants his bones

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chasen sends Alpha Flight to bring Wolverine home and lets them think he is rejoining. Learning the truth, they storm the lab and beat his android guards.
stages.whoA: His team, which turns on him
stages.whoB: The general who lied to them

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago, Heather and her husband James find the feral Logan and nurse him back to health. Now she lures him back for Department H's tests, then quits to stop Chasen and begs Wolverine to spare her husband.
stages.whoA: The man she once nursed and still cares for
stages.whoB: An old friend who betrays and then saves him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine tracks the new Juggernaut to a dance club, where Eugene is trying to impress women. Wolverine offers him some advice, then grabs the ruby so it can go back to Cain.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who takes the ruby
stages.whoB: The accidental new Juggernaut

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops and Wolverine hunt for the ruby and the new Juggernaut near the Cyttorak ruins. They corner Eugene and take the gem, and he turns back to normal.
stages.whoA: An X-Man sent after the ruby
stages.whoB: The accidental new Juggernaut

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Genosha a big collared slave doubts Jubilee's escape plan, then joins her revolt when she gives the signal. The guards stop them, and Jubilee is taken away.
stages.whoA: The girl who leads the slave revolt
stages.whoB: A fellow slave who joins her revolt

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob is part of Mystique's gang sent to kill Senator Kelly. While she poses as Gambit, Blob joins Avalanche and Pyro in the attack on the Capitol.
stages.whoA: The shape-shifter who leads his gang
stages.whoB: A thug in her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob, Avalanche and Pyro pull a paid job that draws the X-Men out. Later they keep the X-Men busy outside Midtown Hospital while Mystique goes after Rogue.
stages.whoA: His boss, who sends him after the X-Men
stages.whoB: Hired muscle for her scheme

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob tries to flatten the X-Men at the Capitol. Wolverine knocks him into a pool of water.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who knocks him into a pool
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood thug at the Capitol

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Blob brawls with Wolverine outside Midtown Hospital, until Storm's hurricane blows him away.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he brawls with again
stages.whoB: A thug he keeps beating

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At the Capitol, Storm calls up an arctic wind and freezes Blob in the pool Wolverine knocked him into.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who freezes him in ice
stages.whoB: A thug she freezes at the Capitol

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Outside Midtown Hospital, Storm blasts Blob with a gale while he fights the X-Men.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who blows him away
stages.whoB: A thug she blasts with a gale

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Garokk's priestess Zaladane steers Sauron into kidnapping Storm, and Garokk reveals that he planted that urge. When Garokk starts to absorb the land's power, Sauron drains it from him until both are spent.
stages.whoA: The man he used, who drains him
stages.whoB: The stone god who used him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Garokk needs Storm's power at full fury, so Sauron hypnotizes her and her storms feed him. When she fights him with cold and heat, she only makes him stronger.
stages.whoA: The weather witch whose power he feeds on
stages.whoB: The god who feeds on her power

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine slashes at Garokk as his stone spreads across the Savage Land, but cannot stop him from heading for the volcanoes.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who attacks him
stages.whoB: The stone god he fights

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George fights the X-Men for Sinister in the Nasty Boys. He delivers Scott and Jean to Sinister in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: His master, Mister Sinister
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and the Nasty Boys snatch Jean for Sinister. Sinister then calls George in to cover him when the X-Men stop his grab for Xavier.
stages.whoA: His master, Mister Sinister
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Nasty Boys attack Scott and Jean for Sinister. Later George brings the captured pair to Sinister in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Nasty Boys crash Scott and Jean's wedding day and take Jean through a portal. Cyclops then breaks into Sinister's lair.
stages.whoA: The groom whose bride he snatches
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who takes Jean

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and the Nasty Boys go after Jean and Scott for Sinister. In the Savage Land he hands both of them over.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who captures her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Jean's wedding day the Nasty Boys grab her and toss her through a portal to Sinister.
stages.whoA: The bride he snatches for Sinister
stages.whoB: A Nasty Boy who kidnaps her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On the beach, George reaches for Gambit with 'Come to Gorgeous, pretty boy!' Gambit dodges him and calls him a walking tar pit.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he grabs for
stages.whoB: A gooey Nasty Boy he fights

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mojo calls for Gog to gather his crew and join the hunt for Longshot on Earth. Mojo orders him to cancel the heroes, then begs him for help when Longshot pins him.
stages.whoA: His master, Mojo
stages.whoB: One of his hunters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gog joins Mojo's hunt for the runaway star Longshot on Earth. Longshot and the X-Men beat the hunters and wreck the broadcast.
stages.whoA: The runaway star he hunts
stages.whoB: A hunter Mojo sends after him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah serves in Corsair's Starjammers as they fight D'Ken. Later they follow Corsair to Earth to protect young Jandra from the Shi'ar police.
stages.whoA: Her captain
stages.whoB: One of his Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah fights beside the X-Men against D'Ken. On Earth she turns on Storm, thinking the X-Men betrayed Corsair, until the two sides team up again.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who fought beside her
stages.whoB: A Starjammer who fought beside her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah and the Starjammers seize the M'Kraan Crystal, then battle Emperor D'Ken and his Imperial Guard when he tries to take its power.
stages.whoA: The emperor she fights
stages.whoB: One of Corsair's rebel Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary lures Magneto to Wundagore with a false Magda and takes his DNA for his new race. He reveals that Magneto is the twins' father, then flees as Magneto fights back.
stages.whoA: The mutant whose DNA he steals
stages.whoB: The geneticist who traps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine follows Magneto to Wundagore, where he is gassed and held prisoner with him. The High Evolutionary escapes once the X-Men break in.
stages.whoA: An X-Man he captures
stages.whoB: The geneticist who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Beast and Xavier reach Wundagore, the High Evolutionary orders his creatures to bring him the blue one. Beast and the X-Men fight his creatures, and the valley fades after its master flees.
stages.whoA: The blue mutant he wants for himself
stages.whoB: The geneticist who wants to take him

changes.was: Years ago, Heather and her husband James find the feral Logan and nurse him back to health. Now she lures him back for Department H's tests, then quits to stop Chasen and begs James to let him go.
changes.now: Years ago, Heather and her husband James find the feral Logan and nurse him back to health. Now she lures him back for Department H's tests, then quits to stop Chasen and begs Wolverine to spare her husband.
changes.why: At the end Wolverine has James pinned and Heather says 'You cared for me once. If you still do, let my husband go'; she begs Wolverine to spare James, not James to free Wolverine.
